PalletTown_Text_OakDontGoOut: OAK: Hey! Wait! Don't go out!
PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon:
OAK: It's unsafe! Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!
You need your own POKéMON for your protection.
I know! Here, come with me!
PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo:
I'm raising POKéMON, too.
When they get strong, they can protect me.
PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC:
Technology is incredible!
You can now store and recall items and POKéMON as data via PC.
PalletTown_Text_TownSign: PALLET TOWN Shades of your journey await!
PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}! You're back, are you?
How much have you filled in your POKéDEX?
May I see it?
Let's see…
PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEf:
You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…
Hm, it looks as if you're putting in an honest effort.
When you manage to fill it some more, come show me, please.
PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowM:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!? Now, this is impressive!
There's something I wanted to ask of you, {PLAYER}.
Come. Follow me.
PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}! You seem to be enjoying traveling.
Knowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily imagine you going out to even more exotic locales.
Good for you, good for you. Hohoho.
